proposal.reasoning: The goblin_warrior_2 is blocking the exits and actively attacking. I cannot flee to the library or armory, and I have no weapon. Attacking is the only way to eliminate the threat; with 31 HP remaining on the goblin and my attack of 10, it will take four hits, but defending only prolongs the fight and I will die. Attacking gives a chance to kill it before it kills me.
proposal.goal_description: Gather information about weapons or the ash
proposal.goal_evidence: Arm yourself with a weapon before you follow the ash, because what waits at the shrine will not be polite.
